fields.statement: At b297efa: make -n update PREFIX=<mktemp dir> printed mkdir -p, then go build ... -o <tmp>/rhiza ./cmd/rhiza, then <tmp>/rhiza rex install, with no cp (the update target depends on install, which builds in place). go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestMakeUpdateDryRun -count=1 -v PASSED. The test asserts the go build -o <tmp>/rhiza line comes before <tmp>/rhiza rex install and that no cp field appears. A compiled test binary run with PATH=/nonexistent SKIPPED with 'make is not on PATH'. rhiza rex install --help confirms it rewrites the Rex config and reloads Rex. fmt-check, vet and go test ./... all pass. make check fails only in self-check, on stale .rhiza/rendered actor and index files from this run's own bookkeeping, not on the leaf's diff.
